Name: Nyapu-Style Pelican Town Municipal
Author: nugmods
Description:
Nyapu portraits I made for the new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38698?tab=description]Pelican Town Municipal[/url], a lovely and thoughtful mod that adds a sheriff and a municipal building to Pelican Town.

Big thanks to Nyapu for their generous permissions, allowing me to use some of their assets and some of my own work to create these portraits. And big thanks to Midnight, who patched her entire mod to help me implement these portraits when I was tearing my hair out trying to get Alicia's shop portraits to work!

Drag and drop into your mods folder, that's all you need to do.

[b]Credits:
[/b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url] - for Nyapu's Portraits and the assets used in this mod
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MidnightVoyager?gameId=1303]MidnightVoyager[/url] - for Bill, Alicia, and Pelican Town Municipal!

Downloads.Description: Make sure you download the latest version of Pelican Town Municipal.
